Official PBP sit Week 1 (Baylor box 28641 / ESPN 401856636): 78 Auburn snaps. 72 No Huddle-Shotgun, 4 Shotgun, 1 No Huddle (4th-and-5 Mabson), 0 under-center. 25 of 26 completions tagged short. 10/18 on 3rd, 0-1 on 4th.
Box-confirmed Week 1: Auburn 17, Baylor 16. Brown 26/35, 259, 0 TD, 3 INT. Rushing 21-27-1 TD, long 21 (16 designed/keep + 5 sacks in the PBP).
Keep is the close-game plan. Winning score: 3rd-and-3 keep left 11. Previous snap keep left 5. Earlier: Cain bounce right 25 then Cobb right 15 TD.
Chunks were short throws that ran: Koger 30 (caught at the 40), Nimrod 26 (caught at the 37), Singleton 20 and 18. One true deep: Koger 21, then INT to Bush at the 4.
Three INTs all off-schedule: deep-left after the 21, 3rd-and-18 after the sack, first play of Q4 (Gifford).
They will go on 4th-and-medium: 4th-and-5 Mabson middle +2, downs. Not a fake punt in the PBP.
Box-confirmed Week 1 run game: Jeremiah Cobb 12-53-1 TD; Bryce Cain 1-25; Omar Mabson II 5-19; team 41-130, 3.2 YPC, 2 TD.
Box-confirmed Week 1 receivers: Keshaun Singleton 7-89-0, long 20; Jeremiah Koger 5-66-0, long 30; Chas Nimrod 4-41; Jake Johnson 3-20.

Winning score was keep left 11. Cain bounce 25 then Cobb 15. Chunks were short throws that ran — Koger 30, Nimrod 26. Three picks when he was off schedule. They will go on 4th-and-medium (0-1).
